question.en: Which of the following is an uncountable noun that is always singular and never takes '-s' or '-es'?
question.hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा एक अनियंत्रित (अगणनीय) संज्ञा है जो हमेशा एकवचन होती है और कभी भी '-s' या '-es' नहीं लेती है?

explanation.en: Words like 'furniture', 'advice', 'scenery', and 'information' are uncountable nouns and are always singular.
explanation.hi: 'furniture', 'advice', 'scenery' और 'information' जैसे शब्द अनियंत्रित संज्ञाएं हैं और हमेशा एकवचन में रहते हैं।

question.en: Choose the correct preposition to fill in the blank: He is junior _____ me in the office.
question.hi: रिक्त स्थान भरने के लिए सही पूर्वसर्ग चुनें: He is junior _____ me in the office.

explanation.en: Latin comparatives like junior, senior, superior, inferior, and preferable always take 'to', never 'than'.
explanation.hi: जूनियर, सीनियर, सुपीरियर, इनफीरियर और प्रिफरेबल जैसे लैटिन तुलनात्मक शब्द हमेशा 'to' लेते हैं, कभी 'than' नहीं।

question.en: What is the correct correlative conjunction pair for the word 'No sooner'?
question.hi: 'No sooner' शब्द के लिए सही सहसंबद्ध संयोजन जोड़ी क्या है?

explanation.en: The correlative pair for 'No sooner' is always 'than' (No sooner... than).
explanation.hi: 'No sooner' के लिए सहसंबद्ध जोड़ी हमेशा 'than' होती है।

question.en: Which word indicates addition (in addition to), as opposed to physical proximity?
question.hi: कौन सा शब्द भौतिक समीपता के विपरीत, योग (अतिरिक्त) को इंगित करता है?

explanation.en: 'Beside' means next to (proximity), while 'Besides' means in addition to (addition).
explanation.hi: 'Beside' का अर्थ पास में (समीपता) है, जबकि 'Besides' का अर्थ इसके अतिरिक्त (addition) है।

question.en: Choose the correct preposition to divide a prize _____ two brothers.
question.hi: दो भाइयों के बीच पुरस्कार बांटने के लिए सही पूर्वसर्ग चुनें: divide a prize _____ two brothers.

explanation.en: 'Between' is strictly used for two entities or persons, whereas 'among' is used for more than two.
explanation.hi: 'Between' का प्रयोग सख्ती से दो संस्थाओं या व्यक्तियों के लिए किया जाता है, जबकि 'among' का प्रयोग दो से अधिक के लिए होता है।

question.en: Which of the following sentences correctly uses an uncountable noun?
question.hi: निम्नलिखित में से किस वाक्य में अनउगणीय संज्ञा का सही उपयोग किया गया है?

explanation.en: 'Advice' is uncountable; it takes no 'a/an', no plural '-s', and uses quantifiers like 'some piece of' or 'some'.
explanation.hi: 'Advice' अनगणनीय है; यह 'a/an' या बहुवचन '-s' नहीं लेता है और 'some' जैसे परिमाणकों का उपयोग करता है।

question.en: Identify the correct correlative pair for 'Hardly / Scarcely'.
question.hi: 'Hardly / Scarcely' के लिए सही सहसंबद्ध जोड़ी पहचानें।

explanation.en: Hardly or Scarcely is always followed by 'when' (or 'before').
explanation.hi: Hardly या Scarcely के बाद हमेशा 'when' आता है।

question.en: Which of the following active transitive verbs should NOT be followed by a preposition directly?
question.hi: निम्नलिखित में से किस सक्रिय सकर्मक क्रिया के तुरंत बाद पूर्वसर्ग (preposition) का प्रयोग नहीं होना चाहिए?

explanation.en: Verbs like 'discuss', 'describe', 'reach', 'order', and 'resemble' take NO prepositions directly after them in active voice.
explanation.hi: 'discuss', 'describe', 'reach', 'order' और 'resemble' जैसी क्रियाएं सक्रिय आवाज में अपने ठीक बाद किसी पूर्वसर्ग को नहीं लेती हैं।

question.en: Choose the correct option: Distribute the sweets _____ the crowd of fifty people.
question.hi: सही विकल्प चुनें: Distribute the sweets _____ the crowd of fifty people.

explanation.en: Since there are 50 people (more than two), 'among' is the correct choice.
explanation.hi: चूँकि 50 लोग हैं (दो से अधिक), इसलिए 'among' सही विकल्प है।

question.en: Select the correct sentence regarding physical proximity.
question.hi: भौतिक समीपता के संबंध में सही वाक्य का चयन करें।

explanation.en: 'Beside' means next to or by the side of, indicating physical proximity.
explanation.hi: 'Beside' का अर्थ पास में या बगल में होता है, जो भौतिक समीपता को दर्शाता है।

question.en: Identify the error in the sentence: 'Neither the teacher nor the students was present in the class.'
question.hi: वाक्य में त्रुटि पहचानें: 'Neither the teacher nor the students was present in the class.'

explanation.en: In 'Neither...nor', the verb matches the nearest subject ('students' is plural, so use 'were').
explanation.hi: 'Neither...nor' में, क्रिया निकटतम विषय से मेल खाती है ('students' बहुवचन है, इसलिए 'were' का उपयोग करें)।

question.en: Choose the correct verb form: 'The captain, along with his crew members, _____ drowned.'
question.hi: सही क्रिया रूप चुनें: 'The captain, along with his crew members, _____ drowned.'

explanation.en: When subjects are joined by 'along with' / 'as well as', the verb matches the FIRST subject ('The captain' is singular, so 'was').
explanation.hi: जब विषयों को 'along with' / 'as well as' से जोड़ा जाता है, तो क्रिया पहले विषय से मेल खाती है ('The captain' एकवचन है, इसलिए 'was')।

question.en: Which of the following sentences is grammatically correct?
question.hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से सही है?

text.en: He ordered for a cup of tea.
text.hi: He ordered for a cup of tea.

text.en: He ordered a cup of tea.
text.hi: He ordered a cup of tea.

text.en: He ordered to a cup of tea.
text.hi: He ordered to a cup of tea.

text.en: He ordered on a cup of tea.
text.hi: He ordered on a cup of tea.

explanation.en: 'Order' is an active transitive verb and takes no preposition directly after it.
explanation.hi: 'Order' एक सक्रिय सकर्मक क्रिया है और इसके तुरंत बाद कोई पूर्वसर्ग नहीं आता है।

question.en: Identify the correct sentence using Latin comparatives:
question.hi: लैटिन तुलनात्मक शब्दों का उपयोग करके सही वाक्य पहचानें:

text.en: Milk is more preferable to tea.
text.hi: Milk is more preferable to tea.

text.en: Milk is most preferable than tea.
text.hi: Milk is most preferable than tea.

explanation.en: 'Preferable' takes 'to' and does not need 'more' since it already expresses a comparative sense.
explanation.hi: 'Preferable' के साथ 'to' आता है और इसमें 'more' लगाने की आवश्यकता नहीं होती है।

question.en: Choose the correct option to fill in the blank: Hardling had I reached the station _____ the train departed.
question.hi: रिक्त स्थान भरने के लिए सही विकल्प चुनें: Hardly had I reached the station _____ the train departed.

explanation.en: The correlative pair for 'Hardly' is always 'when'.
explanation.hi: 'Hardly' के लिए सहसंबद्ध जोड़ी हमेशा 'when' होती है।

question.en: Find the incorrect sentence among the following:
question.hi: निम्नलिखित में से गलत वाक्य ज्ञात कीजिए:

text.en: The sceneries of Kashmir are charming.
text.hi: The sceneries of Kashmir are charming.

text.en: The scenery of Kashmir is charming.
text.hi: The scenery of Kashmir is charming.

explanation.en: 'Scenery' is an uncountable noun and cannot be pluralized as 'sceneries'.
explanation.hi: 'Scenery' एक अनियंत्रित संज्ञा है और इसे 'sceneries' के रूप में बहुवचन नहीं बनाया जा सकता है।

question.en: Select the correct form: 'Neither the manager nor his assistants _____ present at the meeting.'
question.hi: सही रूप चुनें: 'Neither the manager nor his assistants _____ present at the meeting.'

explanation.en: With 'neither...nor', the verb agrees with the nearest subject ('assistants' is plural, so 'were').
explanation.hi: 'neither...nor' के साथ, क्रिया निकटतम विषय से सहमत होती है ('assistants' बहुवचन है, इसलिए 'were')।

question.en: Which sentence correctly demonstrates the use of 'Between'?
question.hi: कौन सा वाक्य 'Between' के उपयोग को सही ढंग से प्रदर्शित करता है?

text.en: The secret was shared between the three friends.
text.hi: The secret was shared between the three friends.

text.en: Distribute the work between you and me.
text.hi: Distribute the work between you and me.

text.en: Peace must be maintained between all nations of the world.
text.hi: Peace must be maintained between all nations of the world.

explanation.en: 'Between' is strictly used for 2 entities (you and me). For more than 2, 'among' is used.
explanation.hi: 'Between' का प्रयोग सख्ती से 2 इकाइयों के लिए किया जाता है।

question.en: Identify the sentence that violates the active transitive verb rule (no preposition):
question.hi: उस वाक्य को पहचानिए जो सक्रिय सकर्मक क्रिया नियम का उल्लंघन करता है:

explanation.en: 'Describe' is a transitive verb and does not take 'about' after it.
explanation.hi: 'Describe' एक सकर्मक क्रिया है और इसके बाद 'about' नहीं आता है।

question.en: Fill in the blank with the correct word: _____ his salary, he received a handsome bonus.
question.hi: सही शब्द से रिक्त स्थान भरें: _____ his salary, he received a handsome bonus.

explanation.en: 'Besides' means in addition to. In addition to his salary, he received a bonus.
explanation.hi: 'Besides' का अर्थ 'के अतिरिक्त' होता है।

question.en: Analyze the sentence and find the error: 'No sooner did the sun rise when the fog disappeared.'
question.hi: वाक्य का विश्लेषण करें और त्रुटि ढूंढें: 'No sooner did the sun rise when the fog disappeared.'

explanation.en: The correlative pair for 'No sooner' is strictly 'than', not 'when'.
explanation.hi: 'No sooner' के लिए सहसंबद्ध जोड़ी सख्ती से 'than' है, न कि 'when'।

question.en: Spot the grammatical error in the following complex sentence: 'The director, along with his core team members and advisors, are launching a new scheme for UP youth.'
question.hi: निम्नलिखित जटिल वाक्य में व्याकरण संबंधी त्रुटि का पता लगाएं: 'The director, along with his core team members and advisors, are launching a new scheme for UP youth.'

explanation.en: With 'along with', the verb agrees with the first subject ('The director' is singular, hence 'is').
explanation.hi: 'along with' के साथ, क्रिया पहले विषय के अनुसार होती है ('The director' एकवचन है, इसलिए 'is')।

question.en: Choose the structurally flawless sentence among the given options:
question.hi: दिए गए विकल्पों में से संरचनात्मक रूप से निर्दोष वाक्य चुनें:

text.en: Scarcely had she stepped out than it started raining heavily.
text.hi: Scarcely had she stepped out than it started raining heavily.

text.en: Scarcely had she stepped out when it started raining heavily.
text.hi: Scarcely had she stepped out when it started raining heavily.

text.en: Scarcely she had stepped out when it started raining heavily.
text.hi: Scarcely she had stepped out when it started raining heavily.

text.en: Scarcely did she stepped out when it started raining heavily.
text.hi: Scarcely did she stepped out when it started raining heavily.

explanation.en: 'Scarcely' takes inversion (had she) and is followed by the correlative conjunction 'when'.
explanation.hi: 'Scarcely' के साथ इन्वर्जन (had she) आता है और इसके बाद सहसंबद्ध संयोजन 'when' आता है।

question.en: Identify the incorrect usage of uncountable nouns in UP-centric administrative contexts:
question.hi: यूपी-केंद्रित प्रशासनिक संदर्भों में अनगणनीय संज्ञाओं के गलत उपयोग को पहचानें:

text.en: The government issued important informations regarding PET.
text.hi: The government issued important informations regarding PET.

text.en: The government issued important information regarding PET.
text.hi: The government issued important information regarding PET.

text.en: He gave me piece of advice.
text.hi: He gave me piece of advice.

explanation.en: 'Information' is an uncountable noun and cannot be written as 'informations'.
explanation.hi: 'Information' एक अनउगणीय संज्ञा है और इसे 'informations' नहीं लिखा जा सकता है।

question.en: Which of the following sentences correctly applies the rule of transitive active verbs and prepositions?
question.hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा वाक्य सकर्मक सक्रिय क्रियाओं और पूर्वसर्गों के नियम को सही ढंग से लागू करता है?

text.en: The UPSSSC panel will comprise of ten members.
text.hi: The UPSSSC panel will comprise of ten members.

text.en: The UPSSSC panel will comprise ten members.
text.hi: The UPSSSC panel will comprise ten members.

text.en: The UPSSSC panel will comprise with ten members.
text.hi: The UPSSSC panel will comprise with ten members.

text.en: The UPSSSC panel will comprise into ten members.
text.hi: The UPSSSC panel will comprise into ten members.

explanation.en: 'Comprise' means 'consist of', hence it takes no preposition in active voice ('comprise ten members').
explanation.hi: 'Comprise' का अर्थ 'consist of' है, इसलिए सक्रिय आवाज में इसके साथ कोई पूर्वसर्ग नहीं आता है।

question.en: Analyze the subject-verb agreement: 'Neither the principal nor the teachers _____ responsible for the lapse.'
question.hi: कथन का विश्लेषण करें: 'Neither the principal nor the teachers _____ responsible for the lapse.'

explanation.en: In 'neither...nor', the verb agrees with the nearest subject ('teachers' is plural, so 'are').
explanation.hi: 'neither...nor' में क्रिया निकटतम विषय के अनुसार होती है ('teachers' बहुवचन है, इसलिए 'are')।

question.en: Select the sentence with correct prepositional distinction between 'Beside' and 'Besides':
question.hi: 'Beside' और 'Besides' के बीच सही पूर्वसर्ग अंतर वाला वाक्य चुनें:

text.en: Besides Hindi, he speaks English fluently.
text.hi: Besides Hindi, he speaks English fluently.

text.en: Beside Hindi, he speaks English fluently.
text.hi: Beside Hindi, he speaks English fluently.

text.en: He stood besides me during the ceremony.
text.hi: He stood besides me during the ceremony.

text.en: Besides the river, they built a house.
text.hi: Besides the river, they built a house.

explanation.en: 'Besides' means 'in addition to'. In addition to Hindi, he speaks English. Option A is correct.
explanation.hi: 'Besides' का अर्थ है 'के अतिरिक्त'। हिंदी के अलावा वह अंग्रेजी बोलते हैं। विकल्प A सही है।

question.en: Identify the error in: 'The treaty was signed between India, Nepal, and China.'
question.hi: त्रुटि पहचानें: 'The treaty was signed between India, Nepal, and China.'

explanation.en: Since there are 3 nations involved, 'among' must be used instead of 'between'.
explanation.hi: चूँकि इसमें 3 राष्ट्र शामिल हैं, इसलिए 'between' के स्थान पर 'among' का प्रयोग किया जाना चाहिए।

question.en: Choose the correct comparative expression: 'As a district administrator, he is senior _____ all other officers in rank.'
question.hi: सही तुलनात्मक अभिव्यक्ति चुनें: 'As a district administrator, he is senior _____ all other officers in rank.'

explanation.en: Latin adjectives ending in '-ior' like senior take 'to', never 'than'.
explanation.hi: '-ior' पर समाप्त होने वाले लैटिन विशेषण जैसे senior अपने साथ 'to' लेते हैं, 'than' नहीं।

question.en: Which of the following sentences exhibits a violation of active transitive verb rules?
question.hi: निम्नलिखित में से किस वाक्य में सक्रिय सकर्मक क्रिया नियमों का उल्लंघन दिखाई देता है?

explanation.en: 'Request' as an active transitive verb takes no preposition ('He requested help'), making 'requested for' incorrect.
explanation.hi: 'Request' एक सकर्मक क्रिया के रूप में कोई पूर्वसर्ग नहीं लेता है, अतः 'requested for' गलत है।
